World and biome catalog

Talarin Reach · six design biomes, one initial hub and a staged dungeon.

On this page
Adjacency diagram: reversible gate pairsHub and cooperative dungeon

The Talarin Reach is an original connected region whose water-regulation ruins create a regional conflict between frontier services, wardens, survey crews and coastal communities. The first implementation is Hearthford/Rillmere and a small Thornweald receiving courtyard, not six finished environments.
